name: Oven Chicken Shawarma with Rice and Garlic Yogurt Sauce

components.name: Chicken Shawarma
steps: Combine lemon, oil, garlic and shawarma spices with the sliced onion. Coat the raw chicken thoroughly and chill for 30 minutes or longer if time allows.
Heat oven to 220 C. Spread chicken and onion in a single layer across a lined roasting tray, avoiding overlap.
Roast for about 25-35 minutes depending on thickness, checking 74 C in the thickest thigh. Rest briefly and slice against the grain.
Portion chicken and rice into five meals. Add chilled yogurt sauce after reheating rather than heating the sauce.

components.name: Basmati Rice
steps: Meanwhile, rinse the rice and cook with 500 ml water and salt in a covered saucepan; let it stand covered 10 minutes and fluff.

components.name: Garlic Yogurt Sauce
steps: Stir yogurt with garlic, lemon, salt and parsley. Keep the cold sauce in its own sealed container.
